meta.input: N = total number of affluence tickets spent this event
meta.mechanic_summary: Every ticket spent opens exactly one box. Which of 9 box tiers you're opening depends only on cumulative tickets spent this event (a one-time, non-repeating ladder: the first 10 tickets open Tier-1 boxes, the next 20 open Tier-2, ... up to 390 cumulative tickets). Past 390 cumulative tickets, every further ticket opens an uncapped Tier-9 box. Each box has a small independent chance of landing on its tier's ruby jackpot slot; the jackpot amount is fixed per tier.
meta.caveat: The workbook's separate 'Chances' sheet models a different key/pity bonus-redemption system (gold, resources, VIP points) confirmed via its embedded icons to carry no ruby rewards, so it is excluded here.
